note: Private camp near the North Saskatchewan River about 10 minutes from Rocky Mountain House. Nightly sites share the park with 50 seasonal sites and year-round full-service sites let by the season or month (marketed to winter campers and tradespeople); tent sites at the river and forest edge, glamping tents, cabins and RV rentals. Playground, pedal go-karts, basketball, volleyball and an off-leash dog area. OHVs (no ATVs) may ride from the site to the trail at 10 km/h. --Claude
summary: Read the rates, seasonal, year-round, winter, amenities and policies pages and quoted the Newbook engine (Jun/Jul 2027 weeknights): cheapest site a 23-ft rig fits is C$76.65 a night (30 A power + water), so OVER the C$69 gate; posted 'starting at' C$57/C$65. 150 RV sites incl. 50 seasonal; year-round. Wrote fees (57/57 -> 76.65/84, +extra_person), hookups (new: 50 A, water, sewer), sites (count 150), facilities (+dump, store, wifi), booking (platform/url), season (year_round). Note rewritten.
flags: PRICE GATE - DROP CANDIDATE: the operator's Newbook engine quotes the cheapest RV site for a 23-ft motorhome at C$76.65 / night ('30 AMP & WATER (PF)', same for Jun 8-9 and Jul 13-14 2027 weeknights; XL and pull-through C$84). C$76.65 = C$73.00 + 5% GST exactly, so it may include GST, but the engine does not say; either way over C$69. The site's own pages post lower 'Starting at' figures: C$57 daily (summer power & water, page modified 2026-10-06) and C$65 daily (rates page, modified 2026-04-28) - the engine is what a booking pays. No gateway within 40 km (gateways.py: nearest Banff NP 138 km). Google 4.4 stars from 413 reviews. RV Life $$$ (stored).

LONG-STAY TESTS: (1) price over C$69 - fails (above); (2) nights really for sale - pass, the engine sells one night online and posts daily rates with phone 403-845-4422; (3) no minimum seen (one-night quotes accepted) - pass; (4) nightly share - pass: 150 RV sites with 50 seasonal stated, the engine offered 2 regular + 1 buddy + 6-7 group + 10 XL sites + pull-throughs (count not shown) for one June 2027 night; (5) not a home community - pass. Year-round/winter full-service sites are 'Dedicated site — it's yours, all season' for 'seasonal campers and tradespeople', so a large long-term share, but not mostly seasonal on the stated counts.

OHV: amenities page 'OHV head-out on the trail with your OHV from your site. * The speed limit is 10km/h and is enforced. Please note: NO ATVs allowed.'; policies 'The Operation of OHVs within the Campground permits you to idle in and out from your site to the nearest exit'. A general campground with an OHV side (no trail system named, no snowmobile staging) - stays by the rule; reported for the reviewer.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront; operator claim differs, so re-audited): the operator says 'Located along the North Saskatchewan River' and 'Some sites are along the river bank with views of the North Saskatchewan river', and tent sites are 'Secluded Tenting Along The River'. Imagery: the RV loops sit 60-170 m back from the water behind a continuous forested bank (densest on the NE side); no RV row is within ~50 m across open ground and a view through the trees cannot be confirmed from above. Recommend keeping not waterfront (a riverview call would rest on the operator's claim alone).
